engineering.label: Client Engineering
engineering.heading: Ready to build something that holds?
engineering.note: A new build, an MVP, or an AI integration on top of a system you already run.

audit.label: Architecture Audit
audit.heading: Find out what breaks first — before it does.
audit.note: The system works and the growth curve says it will not. We read it and write down what breaks first.

guild.label: Join the Guild
guild.heading: Not an internship. A crew, a review gate and a cut of the work.
guild.note: You write code and want to build under Principal-level supervision.

mvp.label: New build / MVP
mvp.prompt: What are you building, who is it for, and what has to hold once it grows?

rescue.label: Architecture rescue
rescue.prompt: What breaks today, how often, and what has already been tried to fix it?

ai.label: AI integration
ai.prompt: Which process are you trying to take off people, and what data does it need to touch?

audit.label: Architecture audit
audit.prompt: What is the load-bearing part of the system, and what breaks first when it grows?
